    • itemsAdderBlockId

      default String itemsAdderBlockId()
      ItemsAdder namespaced block ID for modelType.block, e.g. "itemsadder:example_block". When non-null, the block model is placed as a real ItemsAdder custom block instead of sending a fake block packet with realBlockMaterial().

    • craftEngineBlockId

      default String craftEngineBlockId()
      CraftEngine namespaced block ID for modelType.block, e.g. "craftengine:custom_block". When non-null, the block model is placed as a real CraftEngine custom block instead of sending a fake block packet with realBlockMaterial().
